title: Radovsky's better world
description: Hello dear friend, this is my first mod build, (don't judge strictly) there may be bugs, I will try to improve with updates.
body:
_Radovsky's better world_ mod pack adds over 100 vanilla-style mods! These mods create a new gaming experience in Minecraft, covering various aspects of the game, including farming, technology, weapons, a wide range of both melee and ranged weapons, travel, and more.

If you want to experience new emotions from Minecraft, then feel free to download my build!

Since the build is still in beta, there may be bugs and imperfections. Please do not judge harshly
